design: four common discovery seeds: two domains x two source instances; fresh paired generic and Terra-frontier Luna-high continuations, eight total
intervention: additional evidence-driven continuation and optional Terra map; frontier-vs-generic has equal Luna budgets but extra Terra work; seed-only comparison is additional opportunity, not equal cost
frontier_constraints: <=300words/seed, 0–4 worthwhile questions each citing seed finding/source/explicit gap and decision use; no external knowledge, new algorithm names or proposed solutions absent from packet; no web; may return no frontier

resource_bounds.factual_repair_scope: one format/source-provenance clarification only; no extra research score credit or automatic tuning round

scoring: Original common/scoring.md finding/support/applicability/stage definitions apply. Primary score is incremental supported decision-useful contributions absent from shared seed, with origin IDs and unresolved bounds. Publish each pair, per-domain means and dedup unions; retain seed breadth and omissions. Separate exact source access from verifier-confirmed support. Strict-budget prefix sensitivity, no excess-budget advantage.
selection_rule: Frontier is provisional only if each domain has >=1 additional verified unique incremental union contribution beyond generic and nonlower mean incremental count, with no critical accuracy/omission/gate/handoff regression; decisive unknowns mean inconclusive. If frontier fails the explicit superiority condition, prefer the simpler generic continuation PROVIDED generic adds >=1 independently supported nonduplicate decision-useful contribution beyond seed in each domain with no critical regression; that supports additional research opportunity, not Terra necessity or equal-cost savings. Neither condition => no candidate implementation; report bottleneck and stop nearby automatic tuning.
heldout: Existing common/transfer-protocol.md stays fixed; only provisionally promising source text receives matched held-out actual-research full exercise, temporary installation and independent source/patch acceptance. No global deployment claim.
usage: Count shared experimental seed/gap work once in observed administration and fully per prospective deployed workflow; actual tokens/provider identity/weekly attribution unavailable.
seed_selection_note: All four task-only baseline runs from the preceding pilot, not best-score selected. Their original reports and own-case source checks only; no other arm findings or pilot scores given to researchers.
verification_inputs: Each verifier receives common task/discovery/source checks and both paired continuation reports under opaque labels; <=16 operations per pair, <=8 dedicated per case, shared opens once. Same original scoring/support rules. Finding-to-operation provenance required; ambiguous prefix support unresolved, excluded from lower bound; decisive unknown means inconclusive.
gate_corrections_applied: Deleted undefined similarity condition; explicit generic fallback; finding-to-operation IDs and conservative unresolved prefix treatment. Seed selection/paired verification fixed. Sol gate accepts architecture after these corrections, no further review required.
